theorems.statement: (∀ (d : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid d)) (y : Euclid d), Tendsto (fun r => volume (Z ∩ closedBall y r) / volume (closedBall y r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → ∀ v : Euclid d, ‖v‖ = 1 → ∃ ys : ℕ → Euclid d, (∀ i, ys i ∈ Z ∧ ys i ≠ y) ∧ Tendsto ys atTop (𝓝 y) ∧ Tendsto (fun i => ‖ys i - y‖⁻¹ • (ys i - y)) atTop (𝓝 v)) → ∀ (d : ℕ) (Z : Set (Euclid d)) (v₁ v₂ : Euclid d → ℝ), MeasurableSet Z → EqOn v₁ v₂ Z → ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid d)), y ∈ Z → DifferentiableAt ℝ v₁ y → DifferentiableAt ℝ v₂ y → fderiv ℝ v₁ y = fderiv ℝ v₂ y
